reason: We already pay our ERP vendor's AMC and years of fee and student records sit in it, so I am not moving all that for a new name, even at half price. We only need fees and attendance working; the other modules don't matter to me.
objection: Migrating years of fee ledgers and student data from a new company I have never heard of, and finding out mid-session that something is wrong with fee receipts in front of parents.
would_change_my_mind: If they took our data off the old ERP for us at no cost and ran it in parallel through one fee cycle, or if a principal I know in our area was already using it. The exam-centre module alone might interest me closer to March if it works without replacing our ERP.
